_about: Walking skeleton samples. Each item is a raw signal as S1 capture receives it, plus the outcome e2e.py expects.

items.raw_body:
Finebase Labs Refund Policy, version 3
Effective from 1 January 2026.

1. Refund window. Customers may request a refund within 30 days of the purchase date. This applies to monthly and annual plans.

2. Automatic approval. Refunds up to LKR 50,000 inside the refund window are approved automatically by the support team.

3. Larger or late refunds. Refunds above LKR 50,000, or requests made after the 30 day window, need approval from the Head of Customer Success.

4. Payment. Approved refunds are paid to the original payment method within 7 working days.
